```{r setup, message=FALSE, warning=FALSE}
library(r5r)
library(sf)
library(dplyr)
library(ggplot2)
library(patchwork)
library(plotly)
library(tidyr)
library(readr)
library(stringr)
```

```{r build-network}
r5r_core <- r5r::build_network(data_path = "D:/Final-Project/DATA")
```

```{r load-origins-destinations}
origins <- readRDS("D:/Final-Project/DATA/csa_centroids.rds") %>%
  st_transform(4326) %>%
  mutate(
    id  = as.character(SA_PUB2022),
    lon = st_coordinates(.)[,1],
    lat = st_coordinates(.)[,2]
  ) %>%
  st_drop_geometry() %>%
  select(id, lon, lat)

destinations <- readRDS("D:/Final-Project/DATA/schools_sf.rds") %>%
  st_transform(4326) %>%
  mutate(
    id  = as.character(roll_number),
    lon = st_coordinates(.)[,1],
    lat = st_coordinates(.)[,2]
  ) %>%
  st_drop_geometry() %>%
  select(id, lon, lat, places)

cat("Origins:", nrow(origins), "\n")
cat("Destinations:", nrow(destinations), "\n")
```

```{r load-saps}
saps_active <- read_csv("D:/Final-Project/data/SAPS_2022_Small_Area_UR_171024.csv") %>%
  filter(T1_1AGETT <= 950) %>%
  mutate(
    SA_PUB2022  = as.character(GEOGID),
    denom       = T11_1_TSCCC - T11_1_WMFHSCCC - T11_1_NSSCCC,
    perc_active = ifelse(denom > 0,
                         100 * (T11_1_FSCCC + T11_1_BISCCC) / denom,
                         NA_real_)
  ) %>%
  select(SA_PUB2022, perc_active)

urb_rural <- read_csv("D:/Final-Project/data/SAPS_2022_Small_Area_UR_171024.csv") %>%
  mutate(
    category    = str_extract(UR_Category_Desc, "(?<=\\.).*"),
    urban_rural = case_when(
      category %in% c(" Cities", " Satellite Urban Towns", " Independent urban towns") ~ "Urban",
      category %in% c(" Rural areas with high urban influence",
                      " Rural areas with moderate urban influence",
                      " Highly rural/remote areas") ~ "Rural",
      TRUE ~ NA_character_
    ),
    SA_PUB2022 = as.character(GEOGID)
  ) %>%
  select(SA_PUB2022, urban_rural) %>%
  distinct()
```

```{r accessibility-walk}
access_walk <- r5r::accessibility(
  r5r_core               = r5r_core,
  origins                = origins,
  destinations           = destinations,
  opportunities_colnames = "places",
  mode                   = "WALK",
  max_walk_time          = 30,
  decay_function         = "step",
  cutoffs                = c(10, 20, 30)
)

saveRDS(access_walk, "D:/Final-Project/DATA/access_walk_clean.rds")
cat("Walking rows:", nrow(access_walk), "\n")
```

```{r accessibility-cycle}
access_cycle <- r5r::accessibility(
  r5r_core               = r5r_core,
  origins                = origins,
  destinations           = destinations,
  opportunities_colnames = "places",
  mode                   = "BICYCLE",
  max_trip_duration      = 20,
  decay_function         = "step",
  cutoffs                = c(5, 10, 15, 20)
)

saveRDS(access_cycle, "D:/Final-Project/DATA/access_cycle_clean.rds")
cat("Cycling rows:", nrow(access_cycle), "\n")
```

```{r normalise}
# Log normalise accessibility values
access_walk <- access_walk %>%
  mutate(accessibility_log = log1p(accessibility))

access_cycle <- access_cycle %>%
  mutate(accessibility_log = log1p(accessibility))
```

```{r boxplots, fig.width=10, fig.height=5}
p_walk <- access_walk %>%
  filter(accessibility > 0) %>%
  ggplot(aes(x = factor(cutoff), y = accessibility_log)) +
  geom_boxplot(fill = "steelblue") +
  labs(
    title = "Walking accessibility by cutoff (log normalised)",
    x = "Cutoff (minutes)",
    y = "School places reachable (log1p)"
  ) +
  theme_minimal()

p_cycle <- access_cycle %>%
  filter(accessibility > 0) %>%
  ggplot(aes(x = factor(cutoff), y = accessibility_log)) +
  geom_boxplot(fill = "darkorange") +
  labs(
    title = "Cycling accessibility by cutoff (log normalised)",
    x = "Cutoff (minutes)",
    y = "School places reachable (log1p)"
  ) +
  theme_minimal()

p_walk + p_cycle
```

```{r scatter-walk}
scatter_walk_30 <- access_walk %>%
  filter(cutoff == 30) %>%
  mutate(SA_PUB2022 = as.character(id)) %>%
  left_join(saps_active, by = "SA_PUB2022") %>%
  left_join(urb_rural,   by = "SA_PUB2022") %>%
  filter(!is.na(perc_active), !is.na(urban_rural), accessibility > 0)

plot_ly(scatter_walk_30,
        x    = ~accessibility_log,
        y    = ~perc_active,
        color = ~urban_rural,
        colors = c("Urban" = "#2980b9", "Rural" = "#e74c3c"),
        type = "scatter",
        mode = "markers",
        marker = list(opacity = 0.5, size = 5),
        text = ~paste("CSA:", SA_PUB2022,
                      "<br>Accessibility (log):", round(accessibility_log, 2),
                      "<br>Active travel:", round(perc_active, 1), "%"),
        hoverinfo = "text") %>%
  layout(
    title = "Walking accessibility vs Active travel (30 min, log normalised)",
    xaxis = list(title = "School places reachable (log1p)"),
    yaxis = list(title = "% walking or cycling to school")
  )
```

```{r final-dataset}
final_df <- readRDS("D:/Final-Project/DATA/final_df.rds")

walk_wide <- access_walk %>%
  mutate(SA_PUB2022 = as.character(id)) %>%
  select(SA_PUB2022, cutoff, accessibility) %>%
  pivot_wider(
    names_from  = cutoff,
    values_from = accessibility,
    names_prefix = "access_walk_"
  )

cycle_wide <- access_cycle %>%
  mutate(SA_PUB2022 = as.character(id)) %>%
  select(SA_PUB2022, cutoff, accessibility) %>%
  pivot_wider(
    names_from  = cutoff,
    values_from = accessibility,
    names_prefix = "access_cycle_"
  )

final_df_complete <- final_df %>%
  left_join(walk_wide,  by = "SA_PUB2022") %>%
  left_join(cycle_wide, by = "SA_PUB2022")

saveRDS(final_df_complete, "D:/Final-Project/DATA/final_df_complete.rds")

cat("Rows:", nrow(final_df_complete), "\n")
cat("Columns:", ncol(final_df_complete), "\n")
```

```{r stop-r5r}
r5r::stop_r5(r5r_core)
```
